newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: BOXING-HOLYFIELD PRESENTS GOWN TO MANDELA.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-HOLYFIELD PRESENTS GOWN TO MANDELA.

text.p: WBA heavyweight champion Evander Holyfield met President Nelson Mandela on Monday and presented him with his personal purple and white boxing gown.
Mandela, a former amateur boxer, praised Holyfield's style and playfully squared up to him with fists raised when they met at the president's Johannesburg home.
Holyfield was accompanied by his wife Janice and Mandela by his companion Graca Machel of Mozambique.
"He is a three times world champion and therefore his style is the envy of many boxers," Mandela said.
Holyfield retained his title in Las Vegas on June 28 when opponent Mike Tyson was disqualified for twice biting Holyfield's ears.
Holyfield's four-city visit in South Africa included coaching sessions with local boxers.
